session.summary: The session covers plans for an AI-powered knowledge management system, pending open-source model research, and a note to review materials tomorrow.

records.content: Develop an AI-powered knowledge management system to streamline information organization and retrieval processes.

details.title: AI Knowledge Management System
details.notes: Consider exploring existing solutions first to identify gaps and potential improvements. This could leverage recent advancements in LLMs for better content organization.

records.content: Conduct comprehensive research on available open-source AI models that could be leveraged for knowledge management applications.

details.title: Open-Source AI Models Research
details.notes: Focus on models with good text understanding and organization capabilities. Consider comparing models based on size, performance, licensing, and community support.

records.content: Review all notes and findings related to the AI knowledge management system and open-source model research.

details.notes: Set aside dedicated time for this review to consolidate findings and plan next steps for both the system development and research tasks.
